summary: DMARC lets a domain owner state policies for message validation and reporting, but the basic capability does not let a Public Suffix Domain (PSD) set a policy for names below it. This experimental document extends DMARC to give PSDs that capability. It was replaced by RFC 9989.

eli5.summary: Big shared domains like country-level endings have not been able to set mail safety rules for the sites below them. This experiment gives them that power. It was replaced by RFC 9989.
